summary: LEIFRAS Co., Ltd., a Japanese foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting an investment agreement and registration rights agreement with Oriental Land Innovations Co., Ltd. (OLI), a subsidiary of Oriental Land Co., Ltd. OLI will acquire 400,041 treasury ordinary shares at JPY345 per share for approximately JPY138 million (US$0.87 million), expected to close November 27, 2026, alongside a concurrent share transfer of 4,723,000 shares from CEO Kiyotaka Ito to OLI. The board and audit committee approved on October 29, 2026. This is a routine private placement, not a special situation; watch for closing conditions and registration deadlines.
